Property Overview

Shriram Chirping Grove by Shriram Properties is a low-density 12.4-acre boutique development offering 217 independent G+1 row villas situated on Sarjapur Main Road, Bengaluru. Designed to blend nature with urban luxury, the project features a 13,000 sq. ft. clubhouse, private garden-facing frontages, dedicated parking, expansive green open spaces, and smooth connectivity to Outer Ring Road, Whitefield, and Electronic City. Buyers researching shriram properties bangalore can explore Shriram homes in Sarjapur Road, East Bengaluru, with project status, location, and configuration details available to compare.

Shriram Chirping Grove is listed with 3 BHK and 4 BHK across 12.4 Acres, with new launch status and possession shown as Ready To Move. Listed floor plan options include 3 BHK (2,523 sq.ft.) and 4 BHK (2,628 sq.ft.). Residents can explore amenities such as 13,000 Sq. Ft. Clubhouse, Gymnasium, Yoga & Aerobics Studio, Table Tennis & Foosball, and Cafeteria & Reading Lounge, with nearby destinations including Town Hospital, Azim Premji University, Indus International School, and Elite Hospital. Review this Shriram Properties project's floor plans, amenities, and connectivity when comparing flats for sale in Bangalore. RERA Registration No. PRM/KA/RERA/1251/308/PR/200226/003310
